members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id; this is what `value` and `onValueChange` carry.

members.name: title
members.doc: Title shown on the card and carried into the modal.

members.name: subtitle
members.doc: One line under the title, on the card and in the modal.

members.name: media
members.doc: Icon or small image. It travels from the card to the modal header and grows on the way.

members.name: summary
members.doc: Short text shown only on the card. It fades out as the card opens.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Small trailing label on the card, such as a status or a count.

members.name: content
members.doc: The expanded content, shown only in the modal.

types.name: CenterMorphModalProps
types.doc: A grid of cards in which the chosen card lifts out of its cell and becomes a centered modal. The card's box, icon and title are the same elements before and after, so they travel; the short summary fades away and the full content fades in behind them.

members.name: value
members.doc: Id of the open card, or null when none is open (controlled).

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Id of the card open at first when uncontrolled.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the card that opened, or null when the modal closes.

members.name: renderFooter
members.doc: Actions shown under the expanded content. Receives the open item and a function that closes the modal.

members.name: minColumnWidth
members.doc: Narrowest a card may get in px before the grid drops a column.

members.name: width
members.doc: Maximum width of the modal in px.

members.name: container
members.doc: Renders the modal inside this element instead of the page body: the scrim covers only the element and the card grows to its center. The element needs position: relative and overflow: hidden. The page around it stays usable while the modal is open: nothing is scroll-locked or hidden from assistive technology, and Escape, the scrim and the close button still close it.
